definitions.explanation: A suffix added to nouns to indicate that something comes with or includes the stated feature. Extremely productive in product descriptions, real estate listings, restaurant menus, and everyday speech.
Used after a time period or unit to mean 'per' or 'for each,' expressing a rate or frequency.

examples.japanese: {朝食|ちょうしょく}{付|つ}きのホテルを{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I booked a hotel with breakfast included.

examples.japanese: この{部屋|へや}はエアコン{付|つ}きです。
examples.english: This room comes with air conditioning.

examples.japanese: {駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}{付|つ}きの{物件|ぶっけん}を{探|さが}しているのですが、この{辺|あた}りにはなかなかないですね。
examples.english: I'm looking for a property with a parking space, but there aren't many in this area.

examples.japanese: {一人|ひとり}{付|つ}き{千円|せんえん}だ。
{月|つき}{付|つ}き{五万円|ごまんえん}の{家賃|やちん}だ。
examples.english: The rent is 50,000 yen per month.

examples.japanese: このプランは{一回|いっかい}{付|つ}き{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}の{無料|むりょう}{相談|そうだん}が{含|ふく}まれている。
examples.english: This plan includes thirty minutes of free consultation per session.

notes:
From the verb {付|つ}く (to attach, to be included). As a suffix, it is one of the most frequently encountered functional elements in everyday Japanese — seen on menus, in real estate ads, on product packaging, and in spoken language.

USAGE:
Sense 1 attaches directly to nouns: {朝食|ちょうしょく}{付|つ}き (with breakfast), バス{付|つ}き (with a bath), {保証|ほしょう}{付|つ}き (with a guarantee). This pattern is extremely productive and can be applied to almost any noun.

Sense 2 follows counters or time units: {一人|ひとり}{付|つ}き (per person), {一日|いちにち}{付|つ}き (per day).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朝食|ちょうしょく}{付|つ}き: with breakfast included
- {送料|そうりょう}{込|こ}み{税|ぜい}{込|こ}み{付|つ}き: with shipping and tax included
- {保証|ほしょう}{付|つ}き: with a guarantee
- {家具|かぐ}{付|つ}き: furnished
- {一人|ひとり}{付|つ}き: per person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {込|こ}み: included — often used for prices ({税込|ぜいこ}み, {送料込|そうりょうこ}み)
- {入|い}り: containing — for ingredients or contents ({砂糖入|さとうい}り, {氷入|こおりい}り)
- あたり: per — more colloquial alternative for sense 2 ({一人|ひとり}あたり)
